scenes.title: Sonny Wakes Up
scenes.narration: Tonight, Sonny the quokka wakes beneath a canopy of stars.

scenes.title: The Glow Appears
scenes.narration: A mysterious golden glow appears in the distance, dancing through the gum trees.

scenes.title: Fireflies Dance
scenes.narration: Hundreds of fireflies swirl around him, creating a river of light.

scenes.title: Moonlit Clearing
scenes.narration: Sonny steps into a moonlit clearing where wildflowers shimmer with dewdrops.

scenes.title: New Friends
scenes.narration: Other forest creatures gather, all drawn to the magic of this special night.

scenes.title: Safe Rest
scenes.narration: As dawn approaches, Sonny curls up in the soft grass, dreaming of tomorrow's adventures.
